clue.text: See 17
Whole set of left out Drifters' records

indicators.note: left out tells us to omit the letter for left from the word before

parts.note: the whole set is all of it
drifters, vagrants, are bums in American slang

explanation.surface: Every record by the Drifters that was left off a compilation.
explanation.walkthrough: The Drifters were a 1960s pop group, which makes 'records' look like part of the story rather than the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Long-playing discs or collections of tracks issued together are called by this name.

clue.text: Top grade weight reduction no matter which New York location

parts.note: A is the top grade in exams
LB is the shortened form of pound, a weight
any means no matter which one

explanation.surface: A dieting advert promising first-rate weight loss anywhere in New York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduction' marks LB as an abbreviation of the weight, not a loss of letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The city is the state capital of New York, upstate on the Hudson.

clue.text: Take 'C' bra off outside for example, being up for 18-30s?

indicators.note: the shuffled letters sit outside the next piece
off in the sense of gone bad or wrong, so these letters are disordered

parts.note: taken as written
the letter C as written
taken as written

indicators.note: in a down clue being up means the abbreviation is read from the bottom

explanation.surface: An instruction to remove a C-cup bra, posed as fitting a holiday crowd of young adults.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' makes ABRACKET, and 'being up' turns the abbreviation to GE in this down clue. 18-30 holidays are British package breaks for partying young adults.
explanation.definitionFit: People aged eighteen to thirty form one age group, a range used for marketing.

clue.text: Live date source

parts.note: a well is a source of water

explanation.surface: A live feed giving the source of a date.
explanation.definitionFit: To reside or inhabit a place is to live there.

clue.text: Coarse material from bold young man — drive home!

parts.note: a buck is a dashing young man
to ram something is to drive it home forcefully

explanation.surface: A rough fabric worn by a dashing youth who urges someone to hammer a point home.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiff cotton or linen cloth used in bookbinding and for stiffening garments.

clue.text: Was sick of unpleasant time in flipping bar

indicators.note: the pieces go inside the turned-round bar
flipping means the word for bar is turned over

parts.note: a pub is a bar
rough means unpleasant

explanation.surface: Someone threw up after a rotten night in a blasted pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild British swear word but reverses PUB to BUP.
explanation.definitionFit: To vomit is to have brought food up, so the phrasal verb means was sick.

clue.text: Iron suit detailed?

indicators.note: de-tailed, with its tail, the last letter, removed

parts.note: clubs is one of the four card suits

explanation.surface: Asking whether a suit has been pressed in detail.
explanation.walkthrough: Iron and suit both suggest laundry; 'detailed' means cut off the tail.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf, an iron is one kind of stick used to hit the ball.

clue.text: Fool interrupts Irish composition, which results in inflammation

indicators.note: the word for fool breaks into the shuffled letters
a composition is something arranged, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: a nit is a fool

explanation.surface: A clown spoils an Irish piece of music, ending in painful swelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' makes RHIIS; 'interrupts' splits it after the third letter. 'which results in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Swelling of the nasal lining, as with a cold or hay fever.

clue.text: Less than half of processed iron on the object in well

indicators.note: the pieces sit inside the exclamation

parts.note: my, like well, is an exclamation of surprise

indicators.note: processed means worked on, so these letters are reworked

parts.note: it is the object pronoun

explanation.surface: Iron ore treated and placed in a well, where it forms only a fraction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'processed' rearranges IRON into INOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A minority is the smaller part of a group, under fifty per cent.

clue.text: Anger surrounding Black's manual

indicators.note: the word for anger goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: bile means bad temper or anger
B is the abbreviation for black, as in pencils

explanation.surface: Rage around a black person's handbook.
explanation.definitionFit: Scripture serves as a guide; any authoritative handbook is called the bible of its field.

clue.text: Descent of Democrat excluded from transfer of power

indicators.note: the letter for Democrat is taken out of the longer word

parts.note: devolution is the transfer of power to regions

explanation.surface: A political fall as a Democrat is shut out of a handover of power.
explanation.walkthrough: As in Darwin's The Descent of Man, descent means development from ancestors.
explanation.definitionFit: Descent with modification is Darwin's phrase for the process by which species change over generations.

clue.text: Rock-studying person who digs a record by Yes

definitions.note: an adjective phrase standing for the noun, the study of rocks

parts.note: a miner digs for coal or ore
a log is a record

explanation.surface: A rock fan who digs a Yes album.
explanation.walkthrough: Yes is a prog rock band, so 'Rock' and 'digs' push towards music.
explanation.definitionFit: The science of minerals is the branch of geology dealing with rock constituents.

clue.text: It goes into the main dish with rook

parts.note: a pie is a dish
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: Something that goes into the main course with a chess piece.
explanation.walkthrough: The main is the sea, not the main course.
explanation.definitionFit: A jetty is a structure built out from the shore into the open sea.

clue.text: Understood cloth gets done differently

parts.note: cotton is a cloth

indicators.note: done differently means its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Grasped that the fabric gets finished a new way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'differently' turns DONE into EDON.
explanation.definitionFit: To have cottoned on is informal British for having grasped or realised something.

clue.text: Intricate, so designed, one might think, based on 9?

indicators.note: designed means arranged to a plan, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something intricate, so it was designed, a believer in intelligent design might argue.
explanation.walkthrough: 9 is BIBLE: the definition is someone whose thinking rests on Genesis, and 'designed' nods to intelligent design.
explanation.definitionFit: A believer that life was made by God as Genesis describes, rather than evolving.

clue.text: Utter backing of Church includes devoted type, one consumed

indicators.note: the turned abbreviation takes in the next piece
backing means the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
a nun is devoted to religion
I is the roman numeral for one
ate means consumed

explanation.surface: Church support covers a devout person who has eaten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing of' gives EC; 'includes' opens it between its two letters. CE is the Church of England.
explanation.definitionFit: To utter words clearly is to articulate or pronounce them.

clue.text: Improvised acting, so unlikely to be a 14?

indicators.note: improvised means made up on the spot, so these letters are worked out anew

explanation.surface: Improvised acting, so the performer is hardly a true believer.
explanation.walkthrough: 14 is CREATIONIST: someone who will not commit to God's existence is hardly a creationist.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who holds that the existence of God cannot be known.

clue.text: A, um, devotional dude, way out 14 might exasperatedly say so of 19's 20 of 10?

definitions.text: 14 might exasperatedly say so of 19's 20 of 10?

indicators.note: out as in way out, wild or eccentric, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A muttering pious fellow asks whether a sceptic would scoff at the famous naturalist's idea of how life developed.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-references read: a creationist (14) might exasperatedly say this of Darwin's (19) theory (20) of evolution (10). 'Would you Adam and Eve it' is Cockney rhyming slang for 'would you believe it'.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhyming slang for an incredulous exclamation, fitting a believer in Genesis mocking a rival account of human origins.

clue.text: Handy prop for entertainer of little weight (sugar pressure raised by stroke)

parts.note: G for gram is a small weight
sugar and love are both terms of endearment
up means raised
to pet is to stroke

explanation.surface: A slightly built entertainer's tool, with an aside about sugar and blood pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Handy' is literal: the prop is worn on the hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A puppet worked by a hand inside it, used by entertainers and ventriloquists.

clue.text: Blast engulfing Caribbean islands capital

indicators.note: the word for blast swallows the abbreviation

parts.note: darn, like blast, is a mild curse
WI is the West Indies

explanation.surface: A storm swallowing Caribbean islands, a capital disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital is that of Australia's Northern Territory; it also names the naturalist in 17.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief city of Australia's Northern Territory, a seat of government.

clue.text: Politician's full of gas, it's supposed

indicators.note: the politician contains the gas symbol

parts.note: a Tory is a Conservative politician; the 's is a link
He is the chemical symbol for helium, a gas

explanation.surface: A politician is full of hot air, it is said.
explanation.walkthrough: A Tory is a member of Britain's Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: A hypothesis is something supposed rather than proven.

clue.text: Sebaceous thing on cake tray died off?

indicators.note: died off means the letter for died is dropped

parts.note: a doily is a lace mat placed on a cake plate

explanation.surface: A greasy mat on a tea tray that has passed away.
explanation.definitionFit: Sebaceous glands secrete grease, so the word means greasy or fatty.

clue.text: Second team accepts measure has revolutionised means of improving visibility

indicators.note: the team takes in the measure

an en is a printer's measure

indicators.note: revolutionised means turned upside down, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A reserve side brings in a measure that has transformed how well they see.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionised' rearranges HAS into ASH.
explanation.definitionFit: The fluid sprayed on a car windscreen to clean it so the driver can see.

clue.text: See 17
Militia quarantine housing water

indicators.note: the two words together hold the answer within them

explanation.surface: Militiamen quarantining a building with a water supply.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for water, used in English for water-related things and a blue-green colour.

clue.text: Carpenters would use one "you've only just begun" in rough quarters

explanation.walkthrough: The Carpenters sang 'We've Only Just Begun'; 'you've only just begun' picks Y, put inside QUARTERS rearranged.

clue.text: Back way western house mover from time to time

parts.note: RD is road, a way
W is western

explanation.surface: Moving back west from a house occasionally.

explanation.definitionFit: The Time Lord of television travels through time, moving from one era to another.

clue.text: When backing is needed in oil campaign

clue.text: Possession of musical note by Sinatra?
